blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano and Sen. Panfilo Lacson continued to quarrel on Tuesday, this time over the latter’s claim about his anti-corruption drive. In a Facebook post, Cayetano scoffed at Lacson’s statement that he “must be doing something right and good for the country” if his campaign against corruption intimidates the corrupt. Cayetano countered, telling Lacson that “your so-called fight against the corrupt actually empowers the masterminds and those most guilty.” “All you have done is to try to silence the few voices still standing for the country, the Constitution, and democracy.
